name: meme-marketing
description: Create, audit, localize and tune recognizable social memes with platform-aware captions and visual briefs.

interface.longDescription: Turn audience-specific moments into meme captions and buildable visual directions. Audit or localize examples in Egyptian Arabic, Gulf Arabic or English, and tune a reusable taste profile from approved feedback. Images, live trends and file persistence require tools available in your ChatGPT or Codex session.
capabilities: Create audience-specific meme concepts and captions
Adapt cultural references to the target audience
Produce original visual briefs and fallback concepts
Learn scoped preferences from approved feedback
defaultPrompt: Create three Egyptian Arabic memes about late client revisions, with visual briefs
Audit this meme and identify where the image repeats the caption
Adapt these memes to Saudi Arabic for operations managers
